label: copy-phase echo of 3 / p / l
explanation: Reset-gate unit that fires mostly in the copy phase (91% of activation mass) when the input being fed back is the token 3 (53% of copy-phase 3s are active, 48% of mass), p (34%, 23% of mass) or, more weakly, l. Smaller contributions come from q and 2. The largest activations (near max) occur when 3 is the first original token and is echoed at the first copy step (recall_idx 1). In the copy phase the rate also rises at late positions in long sequences. It almost never fires on the first occurrence of a token in the original phase: rate is 0 at t=0 and near 0 from orig_idx 3 on, with some weak firing at t=1-2. It does not fire on the <DEL> step. A diffuse low-magnitude tail on other copy-phase tokens is not captured, so recall is incomplete (dev F1 0.56, mass recall 0.70).
